text: {"answerable": true, "answer": "The DiffTRe diamond potential (a DimeNet++ model) was trained on the experimental elastic stiffness tensor of diamond [W3168247670#013]. Because of crystal symmetry, this tensor has three distinct moduli: C11 = 1079 GPa, C12 = 124 GPa and C44 = 578 GPa. The crystal was also assumed to be stress-free (σ = 0) at zero strain [W3168247670#013]. The simulation used the experimental density (3512 kg/m3) and temperature (298.15 K) [W3168247670#013]."}
